title: Catch a missing SMTP setting at startup
summary: SMTP settings read straight from IConfiguration move into IOptions, checked at startup with ValidateDataAnnotations and ValidateOnStart.

turns.user: forgot to set Smtp:Port and prod died with a FormatException on the first alert. want to know at boot, not at 3am

assistant.body: Got it. The IConfiguration indexer returns null for a missing key and says nothing else. Let's bind the settings to an SmtpOptions class, check it with DataAnnotations, and have ValidateOnStart run the check while the host starts. In other words, a missing setting now shows up as a host that refuses to boot right after deploy.

SmtpSender takes IOptions<SmtpOptions> instead. Only values that passed the startup check reach it, so int.Parse and the ! operator can go. SmtpOptions is now the single source of truth for SMTP settings. Note: read Value once in the constructor.
